questions: What is framing?
If the framing changes, does the picture change?
What is an agenda?
If an issue falls off the agenda, does it stop mattering?
What is gatekeeping?
If gatekeeping breaks down, does everything get through?
What is reception?
If reception is poor, does the message fail?
What is a broadcast?
If the broadcast stops, does the message stop spreading?
What is cultivation?
If cultivation stops, does growth stop?
What is encoding?
If the encoding is corrupted, does the message become unreadable?
What is a filter bubble?
If the filter bubble bursts, does everything outside get in?
What is an echo chamber?
If the echo chamber goes quiet, do the echoes disappear?
What is a format?
If the format changes, does the content stay the same?
What is voice?
If someone loses their voice, can they still be heard?
What is coverage?
If coverage ends, are people still protected?
What is an audience?
If the audience leaves, does the performance end?
What is engagement?
If engagement ends, does the relationship end?
What is an impression?
If an impression is made, does it last?
